Every kmaudit test that commits goes through the fixture's git() helper, which now always passes a git identity, and the eval row passes with no global or system git config.

Grepped packages/kmaudit/tests and src for other git commits.
test_namespaces.py (lines 48, 181, 264) and test_briefing.py (206) commit through the fixture's git(), which used to have no identity; that is the bug this fixes.
test_apm_package.py:161 already passes its own identity.

kmaudit's src runs only read-only git (rev-parse, ls-files).

The commits listed above would fail without the fix, so the row asserts its fails_when.
